title: [Withus Juku] Class Member – History – Same effective date as active class – Latest class becomes active
description: AC-01 — State Transition — Latest-created class becomes active on the current active start date.
preconditions:

- Allow Class Member Start In The Past = enabled
- Student A has Course A LA from 2026-07-01 through 2026-12-31 and active Class A from 2026-07-01 through 2026-12-31; Class B belongs to Course A
- today = 2026-07-27; target_date = 2026-07-01
steps_actions:

2. "Select Class B, enter 2026-07-01, and save."
3. "Open Student A's Class Member history."
steps_result:
1. "The assignment form opens."
2. "The assignment is accepted because the date equals LA start and existing Class A start."
3. "Class A is deleted and Class B is active from 2026-07-01 through 2026-12-31."
